## Phase 1 — Create folder structure (do once)

Open a terminal in your **project root** (same folder as package.json, go.mod, Cargo.toml, etc.) and run:

> **Detected OS: Windows**

```powershell
# Create all .context/ directories (PowerShell)
@(".context/core",".context/domain",".context/session",".context/pinned",".kiro/steering/always",".kiro/steering/session",".cursor/rules",".github",".vscode",".git/hooks",".claude/skills/commit-push-pr/gotchas",".claude/skills/verify-app/gotchas",".claude/skills/review-changes/gotchas",".claude/skills/skill-creator")|ForEach-Object{New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $_|Out-Null}
```

```bash
# --- alternative (Mac / Linux) ---
mkdir -p .context/core .context/domain .context/session .context/pinned
mkdir -p .kiro/steering/always .kiro/steering/session .cursor/rules .github .vscode .git/hooks
mkdir -p .claude/skills/commit-push-pr/gotchas .claude/skills/verify-app/gotchas .claude/skills/review-changes/gotchas .claude/skills/skill-creator
```

## Phase 3 — One-time setup commands

> **Detected OS: Windows** — run this to create all symlinks between .context/ and IDEs:

```powershell
.\setup.ps1
```

> Requires: Settings → Privacy & Security → Developer Mode → ON

```bash
# --- alternative (Mac / Linux) ---
bash setup.sh
chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit
```

---

## Phase 4 — VS Code setup (if using VS Code Copilot)

1. Open this project folder in VS Code
2. VS Code will prompt: **"Allow automatic tasks?"** — click **Allow**
3. `build-copilot-context.py` runs silently on every folder open from now on
4. To trigger manually: Ctrl+Shift+P → "Tasks: Run Build Task"

> ⭐ Never edit `.github/copilot-instructions.md` directly — it is auto-generated.
> Always edit the source files in `.context/` instead.

---

## Phase 5 — Verify Claude Code skills (if using Claude Code)

_(Claude Code not selected — skip this phase)_

## Phase 6 — Per-sprint rotation (ongoing)

At the start of each sprint, update your session goal:

```bash
# Edit this one file — all IDEs update instantly via symlink
# Open .context/session/active-goal.ctx.md and update the goal

# Then rebuild the VS Code copilot instructions manually if needed:
python build-copilot-context.py
```

---

## Phase 7 — Learning loop (after each session with corrections)

```bash
# Step 1: Capture what happened this session
python capture-session.py

# Step 2: Copy .context/session/claude-prompt.txt
# Step 3: Paste into a new Claude.ai chat
# Step 4: Copy Claude's response
# Step 5: Paste into .context/session/pending-learnings.md
#          (below the "PASTE CLAUDE'S RESPONSE BELOW THIS LINE" marker)

# Step 6: Absorb — routes correction to the right skill's gotchas/
python absorb-learnings.py
# → Choose which skill the correction relates to (1-4)
# → The skill's gotchas/gotchas.md is updated
# → build-copilot-context.py runs automatically
```

---

## Quick reference — all commands

| Command | When to run |
|---|---|
| `bash setup.sh` | Once, after placing all files (Mac/Linux) |
| `.\setup.ps1` | Once, after placing all files (Windows) |
| `python build-copilot-context.py` | Manually rebuild VS Code instructions |
| `python capture-session.py` | End of each session with corrections |
| `python absorb-learnings.py` | After pasting Claude's response |
| `git commit` | Pre-commit hook auto-rebuilds copilot instructions |

---

## Troubleshooting

**Symlinks not working (Windows):** Enable Developer Mode: Settings → Privacy & Security → Developer Mode → ON

**VS Code not auto-rebuilding:** Open Command Palette → "Tasks: Manage Automatic Tasks" → Allow

**Claude Code skill not found:** Check `.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` exists. Run `hermes update` if using Hermes Agent.

**build-copilot-context.py not found:** Make sure you placed it in the project root (same level as `.context/`).

**pre-commit hook not running:** Run `chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit` on Mac/Linux.
